children: Not for release to US newswire services or distribution in the United States
PERTH, Australia, Nov. 11, 2026
-- Paladin Energy Ltd (ASX:PDN, TSX:PDN) (
Paladin
or the
Company
) announces it has launched a fully underwritten equity raising, comprising (i) an A$474 million ASX institutional placement of new Paladin fully paid ordinary shares (
Shares
ASX
Placement
), and (ii) a Canadian “bought deal” private placement to raise C$50 million (~A$51 million) pursuant to the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption (as defined herein) (
TSX Bought Deal
), to raise a total amount of A$525 million (together, the
Offer

Additionally, Paladin intends to invite Eligible Shareholders (as defined herein) to participate in a non-underwritten Share Purchase Plan to acquire Shares at the same price as the ASX Placement to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs) (
SPP
The equity raising positions Paladin for its next phase of growth, funding the ongoing development of the Patterson Lake South Project (
PLS Project
), potential resource growth and mine life extension at Triple R, and advancing exploration opportunities across the broader Athabasca Basin region portfolio.
Highlights
A fully underwritten equity raising to raise A$525 million (before costs), comprising:
A fully underwritten ASX Placement to raise A$474 million (before costs); and
A fully underwritten TSX Bought Deal to raise ~A$51 million (C$50 million) (before costs)
Opportunity for Eligible Shareholders with registered addresses in Australia and New Zealand to participate via a non-underwritten SPP to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs)
All Shares under the ASX Placement and SPP will be issued at a fixed price of A$7.80 per new Share (
Offer Price
Shares issued under the TSX Bought Deal will be issued at a fixed price of C$7.62 per new Share, being the approximate C$ equivalent of the Offer Price based on current exchange rates1
The Offer Price of A$7.80 per Share represents a 10.3% discount to the last close of A$8.70 on the ASX on 11 November 2026
Equity raising net proceeds will be used to fund:

the PLS Project’s planning and execution of the CY2027 and CY2028 capital works program and early mobilisation, procurement and site readiness activities, helping protect the critical path and maintain momentum ahead of the principal construction program;2
potential Triple R mine life extension and resource growth;

acceleration of Athabasca Basin region exploration and growth including follow-up drilling at Atlas and Saloon East and testing of high-priority regional targets across Paladin’s broader Athabasca Basin region tenure package; and
balance sheet flexibility by establishing a clear platform through the repayment of existing debt to support the advancement of a funding solution for the PLS Project.
Paladin MD and CEO Paul Hemburrow said:

“This equity raising allows us to accelerate Paladin’s growth strategy in the Athabasca Basin region and advance a range of value-accretive initiatives across both development and exploration. With the PLS Project now firmly established as one of the most significant undeveloped uranium projects globally, we believe this capital positions us to unlock substantial value through project advancement, maintain momentum towards targeted first production in 2031 and capitalise on the long-term outlook for the uranium market.

“Recent exploration success at Atlas and Saloon East has reinforced our confidence in the broader district potential and supports an expanded exploration strategy aimed at growing and enhancing the already compelling PLS Project development opportunity, while continuing to demonstrate the significant upside across our broader Athabasca Basin portfolio.”
Details of the ASX Placement

The fully underwritten ASX Placement seeks to raise approximately A$474 million (before costs) at the Offer Price of A$7.80 per Share, which represents a 10.3% discount to the last closing price of Paladin Shares on the ASX of A$8.70 per Share on 11 November 2026 (being the last day on which Paladin Shares traded prior to announcing the equity raising).

Approximately 60.7 million Shares will be issued under the ASX Placement pursuant to the Company’s available placement capacity under ASX Listing Rule 7.1. Accordingly, no shareholder approval is required for the ASX Placement. New Shares will rank pari passu with existing fully paid ordinary shares in Paladin.
Details of the TSX Bought Deal
Paladin has entered into an agreement with RBC Capital Markets and National Bank of Canada Capital Markets (collectively, the “
Underwriters

”), as co-lead underwriters and joint bookrunners, pursuant to which the Underwriters have agreed to purchase, on a “bought deal” private placement basis, 6,561,679 Shares at a price of C$7.62 per Share for gross proceeds of C$50 million (~A$51 million).1

The Shares under the TSX Bought Deal are being offered in Canada by way of the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption in all of the provinces of Canada (excluding Quebec) and by way of private placement in the United States and offshore jurisdictions in accordance with applicable laws. The Shares issued pursuant to the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption will not be subject to a statutory hold period in Canada. For further information please see below under “Notes – Canada – TSX Bought Deal”.

The new Shares the subject of the TSX Bought Deal will be issued under the Company’s existing placement capacity under ASX Listing Rule 7.1. Accordingly, no shareholder approval is required for the TSX Bought Deal. New Shares will rank pari passu with existing fully paid ordinary shares in Paladin.
Details of the Share Purchase Plan (SPP)

Eligible shareholders, being those Paladin shareholders with a registered address in Australia or New Zealand and who are outside the United States, that held Paladin Shares as at 7.00pm (Sydney time) on 11 November 2026 (
Eligible Shareholders

) will be invited to participate in the SPP. Eligible Shareholders will have the opportunity to apply for up to A$30,000 worth of new Shares without incurring any brokerage or transaction costs. The SPP will be conducted at the Offer Price of A$7.80. The SPP is targeted to raise up to A$50 million (before costs) and is not underwritten.

Paladin reserves the right (in its absolute discretion) to scale back applications under the SPP if demand exceeds A$50 million, raise a higher amount or close the SPP at an earlier date. New Shares issued under the SPP will rank equally with existing fully paid ordinary Shares in Paladin from the date of issue. The SPP offer booklet, containing further details on the SPP, is expected to be released on the ASX and made available to Eligible Shareholders on or around 23 November 2026. The SPP is subject to the terms and conditions set out in the SPP offer booklet.
Advisers

Macquarie Capital (Australia) Limited, Canaccord Genuity (Australia) Limited and RBC Capital Markets are acting as Joint Lead Managers, Joint Underwriters and Joint Bookrunners to the ASX Placement. Shaw and Partners Limited is acting as Co-Manager to the ASX Placement.
RBC Capital Markets and National Bank of Canada Capital Markets are acting as Co-Lead Underwriters and Joint Bookrunners to the TSX Bought Deal.
Corrs Chambers Westgarth is acting as Australian legal adviser and Fasken Martineau DuMoulin LLP is acting as Canadian legal adviser to Paladin in connection with the equity raising.

Paladin intends to rely upon the exemption set forth in Section 602.1 of the TSX Company Manual in connection with the Offer and the SPP, which provides that the TSX will not apply certain requirements in transactions involving eligible international interlisted issuers on a recognized exchange like the ASX.
